targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FROM gold.jobs WHERE last_seen > now() - interval '7 days' AND coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))

SELECT count(*) FROM gold.jobs WHERE posted_at > now() - interval '30 days' AND coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company))

SELECT count(DISTINCT lower(company)) FROM gold.jobs WHERE last_seen > now() - interval '90 days' AND coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company))

SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.salaries s WHERE s.job_id = p.job_id AND NOT s.predicted)) / nullif(count(*), 0) FROM gold.jobs p WHERE coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company))

panels.title: Postings per month and region
panels.description: Publication date from the source, or the first time it was seen. HN goes back to 2011.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT month::timestamptz AS time, CASE region WHEN 'ch' THEN 'Switzerland' WHEN 'es' THEN 'Spain' WHEN 'eu' THEN 'Rest of Europe' WHEN 'other' THEN 'Other / unknown' ELSE region END AS metric, sum(postings) AS value
FROM gold.postings_monthly
WHERE $__timeFilter(month::timestamptz) AND region IN ($region) AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
GROUP BY 1, region ORDER BY 1

SELECT company AS "Company", count(*) AS "Postings",
       to_char(max(posted_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Latest"
FROM gold.jobs
WHERE company IS NOT NULL AND last_seen > now() - interval '90 days' AND coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT CASE role WHEN 'product' THEN 'Product & design' WHEN 'eng_management' THEN 'Engineering management' WHEN 'ml' THEN 'ML / AI' WHEN 'data' THEN 'Data' WHEN 'devops' THEN 'DevOps / SRE / Platform' WHEN 'security' THEN 'Security' WHEN 'mobile' THEN 'Mobile' WHEN 'qa' THEN 'QA / Testing' WHEN 'embedded' THEN 'Embedded / Hardware' WHEN 'fullstack' THEN 'Full-stack' WHEN 'frontend' THEN 'Frontend' WHEN 'backend' THEN 'Backend' WHEN 'engineering' THEN 'Engineering (general)' WHEN 'other' THEN 'Other (non-tech)' ELSE role END AS "Role", count(*) AS "Postings"
FROM gold.jobs
WHERE last_seen > now() - interval '90 days' AND coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company))
GROUP BY role ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Postings by seniority
panels.description: From the job title. Most titles do not state it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE seniority WHEN 'intern' THEN 'Intern / trainee' WHEN 'head' THEN 'Head / director' WHEN 'lead' THEN 'Lead / staff / principal' WHEN 'senior' THEN 'Senior' WHEN 'junior' THEN 'Junior' WHEN 'mid' THEN 'Mid-level' WHEN 'unspecified' THEN 'Not stated' ELSE seniority END AS "Seniority", count(*) AS "Postings"
FROM gold.jobs
WHERE last_seen > now() - interval '90 days' AND coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company))
GROUP BY seniority ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['intern', 'head', 'lead', 'senior', 'junior', 'mid', 'unspecified'], seniority)

panels.title: Most asked · % of postings in the period
panels.description: From the title and description of each posting, see src/jobpipe/tech.py.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.label AS "Technology",
       round(100.0 * count(*) / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM gold.jobs
                                         WHERE coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company)) AND $__timeFilter(posted_at)
                                        ), 0), 1) AS "Postings"
FROM gold.jobs p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(p.technologies) AS u(key)
JOIN silver.technologies t USING (key)
WHERE coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company)) AND $__timeFilter(p.posted_at)
GROUP BY t.label ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 20

panels.title: Share of postings asking for each technology, per month
panels.description: Months with fewer than 10 postings are left out. HN goes back to 2011; the other sources only have what was open when collected.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', p.posted_at) AS time, t.label AS metric,
       100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.key = ANY(p.technologies)) / count(*) AS value
FROM gold.jobs p
CROSS JOIN silver.technologies t
WHERE t.key IN ($technology) AND coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company)) AND $__timeFilter(p.posted_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count(*) >= 10 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Postings in the period · click the title to open the posting

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(p.posted_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Posted",
       p.company AS "Company", p.title AS "Title", CASE role WHEN 'product' THEN 'Product & design' WHEN 'eng_management' THEN 'Engineering management' WHEN 'ml' THEN 'ML / AI' WHEN 'data' THEN 'Data' WHEN 'devops' THEN 'DevOps / SRE / Platform' WHEN 'security' THEN 'Security' WHEN 'mobile' THEN 'Mobile' WHEN 'qa' THEN 'QA / Testing' WHEN 'embedded' THEN 'Embedded / Hardware' WHEN 'fullstack' THEN 'Full-stack' WHEN 'frontend' THEN 'Frontend' WHEN 'backend' THEN 'Backend' WHEN 'engineering' THEN 'Engineering (general)' WHEN 'other' THEN 'Other (non-tech)' ELSE role END AS "Role",
       CASE seniority WHEN 'intern' THEN 'Intern / trainee' WHEN 'head' THEN 'Head / director' WHEN 'lead' THEN 'Lead / staff / principal' WHEN 'senior' THEN 'Senior' WHEN 'junior' THEN 'Junior' WHEN 'mid' THEN 'Mid-level' WHEN 'unspecified' THEN 'Not stated' ELSE seniority END AS "Seniority", p.place AS "Location", (SELECT string_agg(CASE region WHEN 'ch' THEN 'Switzerland' WHEN 'es' THEN 'Spain' WHEN 'eu' THEN 'Rest of Europe' WHEN 'other' THEN 'Other / unknown' ELSE region END, ', ') FROM unnest(p.regions) AS r(region)) AS "Region",
       (SELECT string_agg(s.currency || ' ' || round(s.min_annual / 1000) || 'k–' || round(s.max_annual / 1000) || 'k', ' / ')
          FROM gold.salaries s
         WHERE s.job_id = p.job_id AND NOT s.predicted) AS "Salary",
       array_to_string(p.sources, ', ') AS "Source", p.url
FROM gold.jobs p
WHERE coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND ('__all' IN ($company) OR company IN ($company))
  AND $__timeFilter(p.posted_at)
  AND (NOT ${with_salary:raw} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.salaries s WHERE s.job_id = p.job_id AND NOT s.predicted))
ORDER BY 1 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 500
